memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks to nearby shop without aid.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 4 regular (betahistine, meclizine PRN, atorvastatin, aspirin).
mood: reports feeling cheerful, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goal: "I want to stay independent and walk to the market."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed for vertigo
atorvastatin 10 mg nightly
aspirin 75 mg daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Pure-tone audiometry (right): 250 Hz 20 dB, 500 Hz 25 dB, 1000 Hz 30 dB, 2000 Hz 35 dB, 4000 Hz 40 dB, 8000 Hz 45 dB. Left ear similar. Mild high-frequency sensorineural loss, age-appropriate.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: positive on left side, with transient torsional nystagmus lasting <10 seconds. Consistent with benign positional vertigo left posterior canal.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Since starting betahistine, the spinning episodes have reduced from daily to once a week. Still feel occasional light‑headedness when getting up quickly.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-09-01 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: still independent, occasional use of cane on uneven ground.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait slightly cautious; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 4 regular (betahistine increased to 24 mg BD, meclizine PRN, atorvastatin, aspirin).
mood: reports mild frustration with residual dizziness.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goal: "I hope to feel steadier on my feet."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 24 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed
atorvastatin 10 mg nightly
aspirin 75 mg daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 320 pg/mL (reference 200-900). Folate: 8 ng/mL (reference >3). Hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, MCV 88 fL. No deficiency.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Repeat audiometry: thresholds stable compared to May 2025. No progression of hearing loss.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Had a slip in the bathroom on 15‑Dec, landed on buttocks, no injury. Felt dizzy before the slip. No loss of consciousness.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-03 at 14:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) due to clinic schedule.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: uses cane outdoors, indoor mobility good.
cognition: Mini-Cog 2/5 (positive screen) – plan for MoCA assessment.
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (Dec 2025); gait cautious; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise heel‑to‑toe walk, supportive footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine 24 mg BD, meclizine PRN, atorvastatin, aspirin, vitamin D3 1000 IU OD) – polypharmacy, review Beers criteria.
mood: reports occasional low mood after fall.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goal: "I want to avoid another fall and keep walking to the temple."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 24 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed
atorvastatin 10 mg nightly
aspirin 75 mg daily
vitamin D3 1000 IU daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Complete blood count: WBC 6.2 x10^9/L, Hb 13.5 g/dL, Platelets 210 x10^9/L. Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (eGFR 68 mL/min/1.73m2). Sodium 138 mmol/L, potassium 4.2 mmol/L.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MoCA assessment: score 24/30 (mild cognitive impairment). Domains affected: delayed recall and executive function. Recommend cognitive stimulation and medication review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Neuropsychology feedback: MoCA 24/30 consistent with mild cognitive impairment likely vascular etiology. Advise blood pressure control, aerobic exercise, and follow‑up in 6 months.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: indoor independence maintained, uses cane for outdoor walks.
cognition: MoCA 24/30 stable, no further decline.
falls: 0 falls in last 6 months; gait steady with cane; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 5 regular (betahistine 24 mg BD, meclizine PRN, atorvastatin, aspirin, vitamin D3 1000 IU OD) – polypharmacy, Beers review completed, no inappropriate meds.
mood: reports good spirits, enjoys gardening with daughter.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goal: "I wish to stay active and attend my granddaughter’s wedding next year."
